metadata.description: Your Day-After-Shahadah people championing New Muslim education. Free online Islamic courses, mentorship, and community.

hero.description: Structured online Islamic courses, mentorship, and a community of new Muslims walking the same path — completely free.

resource.heading: One Stop Resource Centre for New Muslim Classes Online
resource.body: If you think back to the moment you took your shahada and became a Muslim, you probably felt both excited and nervous all at once. Like the start of any new journey, adopting a new faith identity can feel really overwhelming at first — there are so many different things to learn and implement. That's where the New Muslim Academy comes in. When you become a member of the New Muslim Academy, you'll have access to a great community of people and resources that are relevant to your needs. NMA instructors are highly qualified and have been teaching Islam around the globe for many years. You'll be able to learn new things about the faith, engage in discussions with fellow new Muslims, and access a long list of experienced teachers and mentors. So join now and get started.

features.heading: Everything you need on your journey
features.subheading: From your first prayer to your first Ramadan and beyond — every step, supported.

card1.title: Video Classes & Webinars
card1.body: Super FUN & STRUCTURED curriculum. Mentors that CARE for you & WILL be there for you. Weekly discussions & academic challenges. Meet & celebrate with other new Muslims.

card2.title: Personal Members Portal
card2.body: Direct access to resource videos, live classes, and a supportive community of new Muslims, specialized teachers, and qualified mentors. They've all got your back at this critical stage of your life.

card3.title: Live Interaction
card3.body: Direct access to all of our instructors — you will never be alone. Our online resource tools provide unique, unparalleled access to a community filled with individuals like yourself.

free.heading: It's 100% Free
free.badgeText: Thanks to generous donors, we're able to meet our high professional standards of service while keeping it all FREE for you. All we ask is that you pray for us too :)

items.quote: NMA has filled a void that life can leave. Once I testified my Shahadah, even though I wanted to drop everything and move into a mosque (figuratively) to learn as much as possible, the constraints of life continued with work and my family. NMA has provided an opportunity to still get more knowledge than the weekly Khutbahs and self study of the Qur'an can provide.
items.author: Chris

items.quote: The mentors at NMA truly care. They answered every question I had without judgment and guided me through my first Ramadan with patience and wisdom.
items.author: Aisha

items.quote: I felt so alone after converting. NMA gave me a family — brothers and sisters who understand exactly what I'm going through.
items.author: David

items.quote: The structured curriculum gave me a roadmap when I had no idea where to start. Six months in and I'm praying five times a day with confidence.
items.author: Maria

story.title: Our Story
story.body: New Muslim Academy started in a coffee shop. A handful of converts, all asking the same question: “where were the people like us when we needed them?” We decided to be those people. Today, NMA serves tens of thousands of new Muslims in over 25 countries — every course, every mentor session, every certificate, free.
